requirements.name: DATABASE_URL
requirements.instructions: Create a MySQL 8 database and account, e.g.: CREATE DATABASE app; CREATE USER 'app'@'%' IDENTIFIED BY '<password>'; GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON app.* TO 'app'@'%'; GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON `mendel\_sandbox\_%`.* TO 'app'@'%'; The account 'app' may also create, change and drop databases whose names begin mendel_sandbox_, and nothing else beyond its own database.

datastore.capacity_basis: Users, one preference row per user, high scores and one small game-history row per finished game; well under 1 GB per year, 5 GB leaves ample headroom.

requirements.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
requirements.description: OAuth client ID for Google sign-in

requirements.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET
requirements.description: OAuth client secret for Google sign-in

requirements.name: google-redirect-uri
requirements.description: Redirect URI must be registered before sign-in works
requirements.instructions: Add {{deploy_url}}/auth/google/callback to Authorized redirect URIs for the OAuth client.
